rows.role_title: رئيس مجلس الشورى — Chairman of the Shura Council
rows.text: The Secretary-General, Dr Humud bin Abdulaziz al-Badr, writes that death came to 'شيخنا المرحوم ... الشيخ محمد بن جبير' and that the ruler then appointed a colleague of eight years in the Council, printing the successor's name as 'الشيخ الدكتور صالح بن إبراهيم بن حميد'.
rows.locator: Column paragraphs 3-4, signed الأمين العام لمجلس الشورى
